mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON rm.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.menu_type = 2 AND m.api_url IS NOT NULL AND m.api_url != '' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.path, m.component, m.query, m.api_url, m.perms, m.visible, m.is_cache, m.status, m.deleted, m.sort FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON rm.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.visible = 1 AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.menu_id ASC
